card.reorder_hint: Change the order by dragging or with the arrow buttons. It determines the priority.
card.reorder_failed: The order could not be saved. Every load needs a priority entity whose value range covers the number of loads.

errors.no-source-grid: No grid sensor configured and no Energy Manager integration present. Set a grid sensor in the editor or install the integration.
errors.no-source-split: Production or consumption sensor missing and no Energy Manager integration present. Add the sensors in the editor or install the integration.
errors.grid-unavailable: Grid sensor currently reports no value.
errors.production-unavailable: Production sensor currently reports no value.
errors.consumption-unavailable: Consumption sensor currently reports no value.
errors.wrong-unit: A sensor does not measure power. W or kW is expected; a kWh meter reports an energy amount rather than an instantaneous value.

warnings.device-no-power-estimate: {detail}: Without a power sensor and without a rated power, the demand is assumed to be 500 W.
warnings.min-power-above-max: {detail}: The start threshold exceeds the rated power.
warnings.no-devices: No load configured. Loads are created in the Energy Manager integration.
warnings.battery-soc-without-power: State of charge is configured but battery power is not. The surplus correction therefore has no effect.
warnings.smoothing-below-interval: The averaging window is smaller than the sampling interval and therefore has no effect.
warnings.mixed-priority-entities: Only some loads have a priority entity. The order then derives partly from their values and partly from the list position, which is hard to predict. Either equip all loads or none.
warnings.reorder-without-priority-entities: Reordering from the dashboard is enabled, but not every load has a priority entity. Without one, a changed order is lost on reload.

meter_mode.label: Meter source
meter_mode.helper: A bidirectional grid sensor, or separate sensors for production and consumption.

grid_entity.label: Grid sensor
grid_entity.helper: Positive when importing, negative when exporting.

invert_grid.label: Invert sign
invert_grid.helper: Required if the sensor reports positive values while exporting.

consumption_includes_battery.label: Consumption includes battery charging
consumption_includes_battery.helper: Required if the consumption sensor already includes battery charging.

battery_power_entity.label: Battery power
battery_power_entity.helper: Positive when charging, negative when discharging.

battery_mode.label: Battery in surplus
battery_mode.helper: Charging power always counts as available. This setting determines whether discharging reduces the surplus.

battery_charge_entity.label: Charge power
battery_charge_entity.helper: Alternative to a bidirectional sensor: two always-positive sensors.

battery_min_soc.label: Minimum state of charge
battery_min_soc.helper: Below this, charging the battery takes priority over the loads.

battery_reserve_w.label: Battery reserve
battery_reserve_w.helper: Power always kept for the battery.

smoothing_window.label: Averaging window
smoothing_window.helper: Smooths the surplus and prevents changing cloud cover from causing frequent switching. 0 disables smoothing.

scale_max.label: Scale maximum
scale_max.helper: Without a value it is derived from the rated powers.

switch_action.label: Switch function
switch_action.helper: “Automatic” switches the automation if a load has an `auto_entity` set in YAML, otherwise the device.
switch_action.helper_integration: “Automatic” switches the automation. The integration provides an automation switch per load.

allow_reorder.label: Reorder from the dashboard
allow_reorder.helper: Requires a `priority_entity` in YAML for every load. With the Energy Manager integration this requirement does not apply.
allow_reorder.helper_integration: The integration creates a priority entity per load; reordering works without further setup.

integration.detected: The Energy Manager integration is installed. Loads, priority and sensors are maintained there; this card displays them.
integration.missing: Without the Energy Manager integration this card only shows the surplus. Loads are created and switched in the integration.
